item.tib: sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'dus pa las bon dgongs 'dus kyis zhal gdams gser gyis 'phreng ba
item.coloph: bon yang zab kyis (kyi) gdams pa 'di nyid/ ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus kyi gdams pa las grol ba 'dod pa rnams kyi don du ston pa gshen rab lha yi zhal nas gsungs te/ pad+ma bdag gis yi ger bkod nas mtsho rgyal nyid la gdams ces so g.yung drung bon gyi gdams pa'i yang snying rdzogs pa chen po gser gyi yang zhun gyi gnad bdag bu med mtsho rgyal gyi (gyis) yi ger bkod nas ma 'ongs phyi ma'i don du gter du sbas so sA mA yA rgya rgya rgya sprul sku tshe dbang rgyal po'i (pos) tshe spungs gsang ba'i gter nas gdan drangs pa'o//
